RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50
An all-male panel does not prove discrimination on its own, but it reflects a lack of diversity and increases the risk of unconscious affinity bias. However, the bank may legitimately have prioritized regulatory experience over statistical modelling depth for this specific leadership role.

Do not cite the panel's gender in routine correspondence, as doing so prematurely can close doors and provoke defensive reactions. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting constructive feedback and the objective criteria evaluated. If the bank refuses to provide feedback or offers inconsistent explanations, consult an employment attorney or specialist to assess whether raising a formal inquiry or grievance is justified.
